description: In a model \(M\models\mathrm{PA}\) with proper standard copy, no arithmetic formula with any fixed finite parameter tuple defines \(\operatorname{Std}(M)\).

  (φ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin k ⊕ Unit)) (a : Fin k → M) :
  ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.DefinesWithParameters M φ a
